charts.title: Global humanoid robot shipment share
charts.scope: Worldwide humanoid shipment units under SAG’s four-form definition. The preliminary, rounded estimate includes wheeled robots. Each published share is preserved. [M01]

source.title: SAG: Global Humanoid Robot Shipments Surged 272% YoY to 19.1K Units in 1H 2026; AGIBOT Overtook Unitree for No. 1 Position

charts.note: Published shares total 100%. Listed vendor volumes sum to 19.0K while the total is 19.1K. This chart does not measure productive autonomous workers or total embodied intelligence. Do not compare its shares directly with Figure 2. Source: Smart Analytics Global, Robotics 360, 10 August 2026 [M01]. Read 12 October 2026. Preliminary and rounded. Preserve published shares; rounded vendor volumes do not add to the reported total. Humanoid submarket only. Not revenue share, installed stock or the whole embodied intelligence industry.

charts.title: Global humanoid robot installation share
charts.scope: Counterpoint’s estimate of worldwide annual additional humanoid installations. Wheeled products are present; the complete counting methodology is undisclosed. The original one-decimal shares are retained. [M02]

source.title: Global Humanoid Robot Installations Reach 16,000 Units in 2025 as Mass Production Picks Up Pace

charts.note: Shares total 100%. This is neither cumulative installed stock nor recognized sales. Its period, source and metric differ from Figure 1. The publication is dated January 2026; its body contains an apparent 2025 dateline typo, recorded in the appendix. Source: Counterpoint Research, annual installation-share graphic, January 2026 [M02]. Original one-decimal shares preserved; they total 100%. Approximate totals do not establish exact vendor counts. Annual additional installations, not cumulative stock or shipments. No direct comparison with Figure 1.

charts.title: Professional service robot application mix
charts.scope: Adjacent-market context. IFR’s survey covers 238 of 1,001 identified producers across the reported service-robot statistics and is not extrapolated to the whole industry. This chart shows the professional-use application mix within that survey. [R03]
charts.metric: Application share of reported professional service robot units (%)

source.title: Market Presentation World Robotics Press Conference 2026

charts.note: The six published rounded shares total 100%; the listed units total 249,568. Sample composition changes annually. These categories do not measure embodied AI adoption or humanoid demand. Global producer sample; do not compare changing annual survey waves. Adjacent service-robot market. This is application mix, not humanoid vendor share or AI adoption share.
